title: Share a clear change
summary: A good shared change has a purpose, a reviewed difference and a short explanation of checks. A hosting service can review it separately from local Git.
introduction: A good shared change has a purpose, a reviewed difference and a short explanation of checks. A hosting service can review it separately from local Git. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A good shared change has a purpose, a reviewed difference and a short explanation of checks. A hosting service can review it separately from local Git.

blocks.code:
Purpose: add club meeting time
Review: only the intended note changed
Check: read the note and verify the time
Message: Add club meeting time
blocks.title: Share a clear change

blocks.text: The change is easy for another person to understand. Publishing it is a separate deliberate action.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a summary for a one-file correction.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not upload private files or secrets while practising collaboration.
For more detail later, use this [Git further reading](https://git-scm.com/docs/gittutorial).
